rendered: The anode-free full cell, built with a pre-sodiated pyrite cathode, is reported to reach an energy density of ∼400 Wh/kg[1]. This is compared with the theoretical maximum for LIB technology, given in the paper as 387 Wh/kg[2] for LiCoO2/graphite cells. So the anode-free sodium full cell's energy density is slightly above that LIB theoretical maximum, and well above the ∼200 Wh/kg[3] reported for recent state-of-the-art sodium-ion full cells. The ∼400 Wh/kg[4] value is calculated based on the mass of the cell components.
